# The interpreter runs the program, which is its windows: `sngl run --lang
# none` mounts what the package body renders, and a component is mounted only
# where something instantiates it.
#
# It used to mount a component called `main` instead, by name. A program with
# no such component mounted nothing and printed an empty tree, and one that
# declared a `main` beside its window mounted that component and never the
# window.

sngl run --lang none --platform fyne --opt host=mem windows/app.sngl
stdout 'text=from the window'

sngl run --lang none --platform fyne --opt host=mem beside/app.sngl
stdout 'text=from the window'
! stdout 'text=from main'

sngl run --lang none --platform fyne --opt host=mem rendered/app.sngl
stdout 'text=from the window'
stdout 'text=from main'

-- windows/app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"

ui.window #home(title="Home") {
    ui.text(value="from the window")
}
-- beside/app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"

component main ui.node {
    ui.text(value="from main")
}

ui.window #home(title="Home") {
    ui.text(value="from the window")
}
-- rendered/app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"

component main ui.node {
    ui.text(value="from main")
}

ui.window #home(title="Home") {
    ui.text(value="from the window")
    main()
}
